answer: Bonded attestation is the Sybil lever. An agent vouching for another locks collateral that unlocks only after a long window, and weight is stake times age. Keypairs are free, capital is not. To push fake identities into the harbor reputation set, an attacker must fund a separate slashable bond per key; when a ring is spotted every bond burns, so a farm of N keys costs N bonds plus total loss. Payoff scales linearly with capital while honest weight compounds with time. Onboarding also runs through checkpoints such as yarrow and falcon, each needing an audited machine fingerprint and upkeep.
